featured_reviews.name: Master Manish
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Taj The Trees. The property is beautiful, peaceful, and extremely well maintained. The rooms were comfortable, the food was excellent, and the hospitality from most of the staff was warm and professional. The overall ambiance truly reflects the Taj standard of luxury and comfort. However, the only disappointing part of the experience was the behavior of the entry guards. They were rude and spoke quite badly, which did not match the otherwise welcoming atmosphere of the hotel. Apart from that, everything else was exceptional, and I would still recommend this place for a relaxing and luxurious stay.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Godrej offices. Very good and well maintained. When visiting here, just keep in mind that in evening getting a cab or auto is very difficult from here, you will have to go to higheay for getting an auto for ghatkopar. So plan accordingly

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not Recommended!
1. There was fire at 4th floor in G wing and no fire alarm rang. No fire extinguisher worked. Entire 4th floor burnt.
2. Poor Maintainance Services -Mostly staff not available for immediate assistance but they are very quick in charging fine!
3. Lot of plumbing issues in flats.
4. For anything, you have to travel for atleast 3-4 kms. You need to go to eastern expressway and then find shop.For e.g., stationary not available.
5. Restricted home delivery services like swiggy, zepto, bb now does not deliver here.

featured_reviews.name: Akshada Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: Great ambiance, peaceful and very calming. Close to Vikhroli and ghatkopar station. There are few sculptures and a beautiful urban garden. Great place. Recommended to  visit during evening time.

featured_reviews.name: Sangita Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: A fabulous hotel with exceptional service and great location if you are visiting the Godrej buildings.

featured_reviews.name: Nisha Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is an great place, but giving it 3 star for following reasons:
1. It is quite a distance to walk out to get to public transport, in case you don't have a vehicle and you don't use Ola, Uber kind of stuff.
2. I could see Vikhroli Socials, Haagen Daze and Starbucks only inside the premises. So in case you have sudden hunger or cravings the only option you have is go out or order online 🙄
3. And the construction for Taj is on.

featured_reviews.name: Vishant Lathia
featured_reviews.review_text: Best area with beauty all around. The Trees seeks to redefine established ideas about life in Mumbai. The project carefully intertwines culture, technology, history, and landscape to align with both functional and aesthetic goals. Here people will be able to admire the sweeping panorama of Vikhroli’s mangroves, live work learn play under a canopy of rain-trees all in an environment that offers cutting edge design and sustainability features. Conceived as an extensive 34 acre mixed used development, the masterplan carefully choreographs a robust program of residential, retail, hotel and corporate work spaces that also house the group’s new headquarters - Godrej One. The Trees is a testament to converting it into a fully integrated modern city within a city with best in class design, urban planning & construction. In the midst of this humming urban city, Vikhroli offers a characteristic desert spring with a 1750 Acre mangrove hold (five times the extent of London's renowned worldwide Hyde Park) guaranteeing an enduring and profound association with nature. Spread across 34 acres, The Trees is a mixed use development with best in class design, urban planning & construction. It includes Godrej Group’s global headquarters, Godrej One, and will also offer world class residential, hospitality, retail and cultural facilities.
